verdict.rationale: Namecheap publishes an official Go SDK in its own GitHub org. It offers context-aware methods covering availability checks, registration, renewal, registrar lock and TLD capability listing. An official Terraform provider and a sandbox API endpoint support safe development. missing for 10: official SDKs in other mainstream languages (e.g. Python/JS), in-depth reference docs beyond README tables, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
